rationale: Both Prajyot and Balakumar work at the intersection of robotics manipulation and perception with deep ROS expertise—Prajyot on the learning and sim-to-real side (Isaac Sim, imitation learning) and Balakumar on motion planning and robotic perception (LiDAR, force sensing). They share C++ and Python fundamentals and complementary specializations that could spark useful technical exchange around end-to-end manipulation pipelines.
intro_message: Prajyot Patil, meet Balakumar Sundaralingam — you both work on robotics manipulation at Meta and NVIDIA with strong ROS backgrounds, and your expertise in sim-to-real learning and motion planning/perception could create good cross-pollination.
